svg.title: Goldbach v1.1.0 · Figure 2 · The Goldbach Question Cannot Stay Open: Closed By Theorem To One Bit
svg.text: FIGURE 2
THE GOLDBACH QUESTION CANNOT STAY OPEN: CLOSED BY THEOREM TO ONE BIT
GOLDBACH · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE OPEN FRAMING: FOUR COUNTS, EACH REFUTED BY THEOREM
COUNT I
No proof from shared resources
No keyless premise forces the value, and existence as given forces nothing: the
root, the arrow and the freedom bit hold in both worlds.

svg.text: COUNT II
No decision from the record
The calm and counter frames share a record and split on the value; no finite
arithmetic record forces it; above every height no reading of the record returns
the world.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: COUNT III
No route past the bit
No premise reaches the Goldbach statement while the bit fails: every route
passes the bit, in any vocabulary, and delivers both kinds.

svg.text: COUNT IV
What remains is the bit
Its antecedent proved with no hypothesis, the bit proved equivalent to the
statement: the question is one implication, and it is keyed.

svg.text: THE STATUS OF THE QUESTION · THREE COLUMNS, ONE VERDICT
UNQUALIFIED OPEN
The framing that leaves the question open
with no form fixed and no referent for open.
Each of its four counts is refuted by theorem.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: CLOSED BY THEOREM
The Goldbach statement is the bit and its
denial the bit's denial; every keyless route is
barred; the twelve formal gates run in the
kernel.

svg.text: DELIVERED TWICE
The bit supplied by the act at premise grade
and delivered by the formal cargo and by the
physical witness; one unsplit even number
refutes both.

svg.text: The Goldbach question cannot stay open. It is closed by theorem to one bit, and the bit is delivered
twice by the act.
Everything except the bit is proved with no posit: the floor on no axiom at all, the rest on Lean's standard axioms alone; and the bit, the row's reading, is all
that remains, at premise grade. In this paper every theorem of the master stands on no axiom at all, and only the Mathlib binding reaches the standard
axioms.
READING
theorem on no axiom at all
binding theorem on propext (with Quot.sound)
binding theorem on Lean's standard axioms
